Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

UDC 621 315-683: 621 '3-049-75 : 620-1 : 621-38-038 IS : 9891 ( Part IV) -1981 




( Reaffirmed 2004 ) 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR EDGE CONNECTORS FOR 

PRINTED WIRING BOARD AND INSULATED BOARD 

HAVING CONTACT PITCH 254 mm 

PART IV NON-POLARISED SOCKET TYPES 
9891 IS-03-11/25/33-W/l-A/B-0'75 



0. General — This standard shall be read in conjunction with IS : 9891 ( Part I )-1981 ■ Specification 
for edge connectors for printed wiring board and insulated board having contact pitch 2 54 mm: 
Part I Test schedule and requirements \ 

1. Type Designation — The types of connectors covered in this standard are designated [ see 4.4 
of 9891 ( Part I )-1981 ] as given below: 

a) 9891 IS-03-11-W-A-075 

b) 9891 IS-03-25-W-A-075 

c) 9891 IS-03-33-W-A-0 75 

d) 9891 IS-03-11-W-B-075 

e) 9891 IS-03-25-W-B-075 

f) 9891 IS-03-33-W-B-075 

g) 9891 IS-03-11-I-A-075 
h) 9891 IS-03-25-I-A-075 
j ) 9891 IS-03-33-I-A-075 
k) 9891 IS-03-11-I-B-0 75 

m) 9891 IS-03-25-I-B-075 
n) 9891 IS-03-33-I-B-0 75 

2. Outline and Dimensions — The outline and dimensions shall be according to Fig. 1 and Table 1. 

3. Material, Finish and Life Requirement — The material, finish and life requirement shall be as 
under: 

a) Material — Glass filled polycarbonate, 

b) Contacts — Brass/suitable non-ferrous material copper base alloy, 

c) Finish —075 micron gold plating or the thickness of the plating as agreed between the 

purchaser and the manufacturer ( supplier ), 

d) Mechanical life — 400 mating cycles or 6 000 mating cycles for reinforced contacts. 

4. Climatic Category — The climatic characteristics shall be as given below: 

a) Temperature severity — 40 to + 125°C 

b) Damp heat severity 21 days 

c) Air pressure ( low ) 4*4 kPa 

d) Acceleration steady state 170 m/s 2 

e) Vibration 10-2 000 Hz 

f) Shock 500 m/s 2 

5. Electrical Rating — The rated voltage shall be 250 V dc and the rated current shall be 
4 A dc. 



Adopted 28 October 1981

Types of Connector Engagement Force Disengagement Force
